_comment: Expansion 3 (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Parts A-C went into the base files; the spell catalogue (Part D) comes as fragments beside this record: spells.cantrips.json, spells.level1.json, spells.level2.json... (realmwalker/data/packs.py merges them).
name: Demigods & Magics
tagline: Twenty levels of power. Every spell under the sky.
adds: Twenty levels through the four tiers, and an epic boon at 19 (Combat Prowess, Fate, Truesight, the Night Spirit...)
The fighter, rogue, cleric and wizard of 2024 from level 1 to 20, with the Champion, Knight, Thief, Assassin, Life and War Domains, Evoker and Abjurer
Every spell of the Player's Handbook, cantrips to Wish: prepared each morning, cast from higher slots, with their costly components and scrolls of every level
Spells that work outside a fight: Goodberry feeds, Tiny Hut keeps the night, Revivify brings back the fallen, Teleport crosses the land, Augury answers from the world's own history
Familiars, a summoned steed, summoned spirits, the raised dead, bound fiends and Polymorph's shapes fighting at your side; and a Simulacrum of snow
Enemies that cast the whole catalogue, chosen by what each spell would do
Priests and mages who cast for pay at the book's prices, scrolls in temples and mages' shops, and the law of magic in every realm
